verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents webhooks that send signed HTTPS requests on repository or organization events such as pushes, new issues and merged pull requests. That lets users trigger actions on events, but only by hosting their own receiving server. Rulesets enforce branch and tag protections, and Buildkite builds appear as checks, but neither is a native rule engine that runs actions when events occur. Missing for 10: native event→action rule or workflow automation, built-in CI/actions runner, configurable automation conditions beyond webhooks, independent corroboration.
